`Handlers.AltitudeWithinLimit` demanded the typed input ahead of the rule's § 107.205 gate -- the ordering thirteen of the fifteen gated entries took before #93 -- by wrapping the argument back up (`Demand(request.AltitudeAboveGroundLevelFeet, request.EntryId, nameof(request.AltitudeAboveGroundLevelFeet))` for `request.AltitudeAboveGroundLevelFeet`). A caller stating a certificate of waiver of § 107.51 in force and describing nothing else was then refused `ArgumentException` naming `AltitudeAboveGroundLevelFeet` -- `FactRequired`, `MissingInput=AltitudeAboveGroundLevelFeet`, filed under `Outstanding`, which `OperationEvaluation.Outstanding` documents as "everything the caller still owes this engine" -- instead of being declined `OutsideCurrentScope` citing § 107.205 (`docs/decisions/0008-the-waiver-gate-precedes-every-other-demand.md`). So this test, which pins one answer for a waived request, the same across every gated entry, went red on both target frameworks: `Failed!  - Failed:     3, Passed:   740, Skipped:     0, Total:   743` for net10.0 and the same figures for net8.0. The others red with it were `WaiverGateOrderingTests.Nothing_a_stated_waiver_suspends_is_reported_as_something_the_caller_still_owes`; `WaiverGateOrderingTests.A_waived_request_is_never_asked_for_a_typed_input_the_waiver_has_made_irrelevant`.
